document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
“Instances of ‘Dementia Antarctica’ have been experienced by 
many parties exploring the frozen continent. The most recent 
and vivid account was rendered by the disaster-plagued journey 
of Lake to the unexplored northwest regions. The bizarre reports 
even shocked people familiar with the phenomenon. The rescue 
party succumbed to the isolation and cold, and all survivors spent 
months in sanitariums babbling about lost cities and subterranean 
horrors. Recently, specialists have suggested that an enriched diet 
will prevent such terrible delusions.” 
Succeed with a Luck roll and go to 184; otherwise go to 138. 
(138)
